en: A colorized aerial view of a European city with a river running through the center, lined by dense rows of red‑roofed buildings and several bridges. The vantage point is from an elevated hill covered with trees, looking across the old town toward flat countryside and low hills in the distance. Printed text at the top reads in German, identifying the scene as a view from the Schlossberg hill looking south over Graz.
